channel.title: Wire — Programming
channel.description: Programming from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Automattic's board forces CEO Matt Mullenweg into leave of absence
item.description: Mullenweg said in a company Slack message that it was against his will. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: Matt Mullenweg put on 'leave of absence'
item.description: Mullenweg, co-founder of WordPress, wrote in a company-wide Slack messages on Wednesday, viewed by 404 Media, that board members "conspired" behind his back to vote to put him on leave. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: Blizzard Workers Win Historic Union Contract
A Design Space Exploration of Async/Await
item.description: Every language pitches async/await as synchronous-looking code, and the same two keywords appear everywhere. (2 sources: lobsters, rprogramming)

item.title: IETF Publishes RFC 10008, Adding the QUERY Method for Safe Requests With a Body
item.description: In June 2026, the IETF published RFC 10008, introducing the QUERY method to HTTP, the first new standard HTTP verb since 2010. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Benchmarking Qwen3.8 27B quantizations: 4-bit holds up, 1-bit collapses
item.description: I test Unsloth GGUFs of Qwen3.8 27B (Q4_K_M, UD-Q2_K_XL, UD-IQ1_S) with llama.cpp on GPQA Diamond, IFBench, Terminal-Bench 2.1. Q4_K_M matches BF16 abd fits an RTX 4090. (2 sources: hackernews, lobsters)

item.title: Beyond Autonomous Teams in Software Product Development
item.description: Autonomous teams are an article of faith in modern software development. The shape of our value determines what we can do; it determines our trade-offs between agency and coherence. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Show HN: What if the speed of light was 5 km/h?
item.description: Special relativity simulator in which light crawls along at a human speed, so Lorentz contraction, aberration and Doppler shift happen at walking pace. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: iPhone Duo
item.description: iPhone Duo. The largest iPhone display ever. In a thin, foldable design. 48MP Dual Fusion camera system. A20 Pro chip. All-day battery life. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: AirPods 5
item.description: Apple today announced AirPods 5, delivering the industry’s best Active Noise Cancellation in an open-ear design and even better sound quality. (1 source: hackernews)
